name: Sashimi
body:
Station and Complexity poissonier 1

Flavor Profiles umami
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 3 rounds plus 1 round/level; Serving Size 2

DESCRIPTION

Sashimi is raw fish prepared with some basic salt to taste and sometimes served with different sides like ginger, soy sauce, and wasabi.

When you learn this recipe, choose one skill. You can learn this recipe multiple times, using different fish in your preparation and choosing another skill each time. If you learn this recipe from another culinarian using the same fish, you can adapt that recipe to another fish instead.

When consumed, sashimi grants skill ranks equal to the consumer’s level in the chosen skill, and that skill is treated as a class skill for the duration (it grants the +3 bonus for having one or more ranks in the skill). These do not stack with a consumer’s own skill ranks.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1.
